Name: Trisha Voellinger
Badge: Reading to Write: Say-Mean-Matter
How might you introduce Say-Mean-Matter to your students? What about this framework do you think will be helpful for them? What might be challenging?:

I am thinking about introducing my students to the Say-Mean-Matter strategy with quotes from Messi because my students like him. I found the quote ""The day you think there is no improvement to be made, is a sad one" to use with this activity. I think the quote from someone they like will make them more likely to enjoy this activity. Additionally, the graphic organizer breaks down the steps, so I think that will be helpful getting their thoughts on paper and making them really think about the meaning of the quote. My students may struggle with the Matter section because they are middle school and still grasping on the worldwide outlook.
